author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
In the past, when you do code review, you have to explain to the writer why their code sucks.  It is a lot of work if they don't agree and try to argue with you.

Now with AI, you can just ask the writer dumps his code to AI and let AI be the judge.   He has to listen to AI; AI is fair and is the authority.   No heated debate, no ego got hurt.
